name: BrochureUnfoldCard
job: A trifold brochure card that opens panel by panel to present a package, itinerary or menu in sequence
visitor_action: click/tap to unfold or fold; swipe sideways on touch; arrow keys step through the panels
mobile: panels reveal vertically one by one
art_direction: Travel leaflet: warm sand paper, deep olive and apricot print blocks, crease shading, fine halftone dot texture
motion: panels hinge open with perspective and eased creases (reduced-motion: opened flat)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
notes: Not yet seen rendered (QA sweep pending): the duotone photo blend, nested 3D hinge ordering and the intro auto-unfold timing are unverified. Layout assumes ~1.32 panel aspect, so very long text is line-clamped. Self-hosted font: Epilogue variable.
